speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The monitoring period has come to an end.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The final reports have revealed serious problems surrounding the wind park.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Bird populations around the wind park continue to show signs of disturbance. The measures taken were not enough to adequately protect the most vulnerable species.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Marine ecosystems have also suffered significant disturbance. The effects of underwater noise and construction have been more severe than expected.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Many fishing families have lost access to their traditional fishing grounds. Without sufficient alternatives, some communities are struggling to maintain their livelihoods.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: The restrictions created by the wind park have placed additional pressure on the port and our shipping routes.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has taken some measures to address these problems, but they have not been sufficient to manage the project's overall impacts.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The wind park has increased Arcadia's renewable energy capacity, but the project has come at a considerable environmental, social and economic cost.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: We focused too heavily on the benefits of the project and did not do enough to manage its consequences.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The experience has shown us that sustainable infrastructure cannot be judged by a single objective.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Arcadia will now have to address the damage and unresolved problems left by the project.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Your assignment is complete. The government will learn from this experience when planning future infrastructure projects.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Your ship is waiting at the harbour. We wish you a safe journey home across the Conan Sea.
